fusions.name: Cast-Off Frond
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A strike with a frond broken from your own growth that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spawning Cloud
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of stinging spawn, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Bright Outcrop
fusions.desc: Plants an outcrop in warning colours that stands for 15 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds, each sting with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: What the Sting Leaves
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
